doc.name: G — 30s rescue mission micro-thriller set in a countryside farm, hopeful in tone, an ensemble crew of four, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: rescue mission micro-thriller set in a countryside farm, hopeful in tone
Hero: an ensemble crew of four
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the rescue mission micro-thriller set in a countryside farm, hopeful in tone form, built around an ensemble crew of four.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Any on-screen text must use the same wording and placement logic in every act.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a top-down descent onto a flat plane in Act 1 against a snap zoom in followed by a settle in Act 3 — while holding the a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second rescue mission micro-thriller set in a countryside farm, hopeful in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same ensemble crew of four.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a gimbal glide tracking laterally at a constant stand-off, shot on a 58mm vintage double-gauss at f/1.8, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side; grade as warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second rescue mission micro-thriller set in a countryside farm, hopeful in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same ensemble crew of four.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a whip pan that resolves onto the subject, shot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/4, framed with frame-within-frame using foreground architecture.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with hard side light with 80 percent of the frame falling into shadow; grade as a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, oversharpened halos, banding, compression artefacts

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second rescue mission micro-thriller set in a countryside farm, hopeful in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same ensemble crew of four.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a 180-degree orbit sweeping camera-right, shot on a 135mm telephoto at f/1.8, framed with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject; grade as a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.negative_prompt: distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality
